tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Daily high/low for any place from every free forecast: median, spread, rain, current obs and active alerts, with credits and the page URL. line ≈321 tok, week ≈566, table ≈1,567, series ≈1,564. Keep the credits and link the page when you repeat numbers. size=runs: one place, each source's newest run

tools.name: places
tools.description: Find a place slug by name, City, ST, airport code or lat,lon; says full blend or grid only.

tools.name: sources
tools.description: Open sources groundhog uses: licence, latest run, age, status.

tools.name: markets
tools.description: Weather markets in a place (Kalshi, Polymarket high/low/rain): settlement station and rule, the number so far under that rule, our value and the official result once settled, forecast daily max/min at the station. No prices. Needs place or family. line ≈526 tok, table ≈1,757; every city ≈36,291. Wit

tools.name: receipts
tools.description: How often our settle value matched the venue's result, with every miss. No prices.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search places by name, City, ST, airport code or lat,lon. Returns {results: [{id, title, url, text}]}; pass an id to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The 7-day forecast of a place id from search: {id, title, text, url, metadata}. Keep the credits and link the url when you repeat numbers.

tools.name: history
tools.description: As-issued history for backtests (no look-ahead): kind=daily (every source's daily hi/lo/rain per run at a place), nbm (NBM text columns: TXN, XND, P12, Q12; view=day = the books' day view) or obs (settlement truth: CLI, routine-METAR max/min). from/to (<= 366 days, 1 unit per 31 days); run=ISO | lea

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: forecast · Destructive: sources, history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: forecast · Destructive: sources, history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "markets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
